mapping.summary: Transportation management: loads, routes, carriers, freight costs
claims: Creates transport requests from sales, purchase, transfer and posted documents
Workflow from source document to transport request, planned load and transport order
Builds loads checking weight, volume, floor space, compartments, delivery windows and driver/vehicle conflicts
Plans inbound pickups, outbound deliveries and transfers between locations
Controls incompatible goods and truck compartments
Calculates stop sequence and route distance using Azure Maps or Google Maps
Compares configured carrier rates and creates freight charge lines
Allocates freight costs to source documents by weight, distance, volume or floor space
Prints loading manifests, packing lists, bills of lading and CMR forms
Publishes dispatch data to telematics providers
Supports own fleet and external carriers
License needed only for users working with TMS
